AzureAd.// ClientCredentials: Mirrors the Dev block: how this API proves ITS OWN identity to Entra for the on-behalf-of exchange that turns a caller's token into a Graph token for that same user (Teams channel lookup, Outlook reminders). Backed by the federated identity credential 'origination-qa-appservice-mi' on the 'Origination API - QA' registration, bound to the app-origination-qa-eus SYSTEM-ASSIGNED managed identity (14bc8ee3-de60-48ea-a2f5-5064ad568371), token-exchange audience api://AzureADTokenExchange. Added by IT Security 2026-09-18 along with admin consent for delegated Team.ReadBasic.All, Channel.ReadBasic.All and Calendars.ReadWrite — QA now matches Dev. No secret anywhere; QA holds 0 secrets and 0 certs. ManagedIdentityClientId is deliberately omitted (system-assigned). Only works ON the App Service: there is no managed identity on a laptop, so locally the Graph calls degrade to empty/no-op.

AppAccess.// GroupId: QA reads the QA access group (Origination App QA Users). Config is ready; filtering activates automatically once the app-origination-qa-eus managed identity is granted scoped read of this group + User.ReadBasic.All. Until that grant lands the member read fails and consumers fall open (unfiltered) — safe.

ConnectionStrings.// ODSDpConnection: Intentionally absent — DP contracts read ODSConnection above (QA ODS), same as every other ODS query. The DP Contracts tab stays empty until ODS loads ctrm.vw_GNTA70D1 in QA; no config change is needed when it does. See appsettings.Dev.json for why no cross-environment override is used.

CustomerSync.// Source: Deliberately NOT set to ctrm here, unlike Dev. The sync runs once for real 60 seconds after every deploy, so a value in this file would make QA's first CTRM-sourced run happen before anyone could dry-run it against the QA database (Dev's dry run of 2026-10-20 covered the Dev database only). Flip QA through the App Service setting CustomerSync__Source = ctrm after: the grant (scripts/Grant-CustomerIdSequence.sql, identity app-origination-qa-eus) and a clean POST /api/diagnostics/customer-sync/run?dryRun=true&source=ctrm. Until then QA customers stay on the ODS views exactly as before. Rollback is the same setting back to ods.
CustomerSync.// CtrmExtendedFields: On already, so the flip above is one setting: all fourteen Stage 2 fields resolve on the nonprod gateway (2026-10-20), and the ACH badge on the ctrm source reads the PaymentMethod column that only an extended run fills. Harmless while Source is still ODS - the flag is read only by the CTRM feeder.

Ctrm.// Source: CTRM for everyone in QA since the 2026-10-06 go-live: every contract and ticket read comes from the Scoular GraphQL API, no toggle. Rollback without a redeploy: App Service setting Ctrm__Source = ods (restarts the app; the switch re-reads config per call).
Ctrm.// GraphQlUri: The QA gateway, which is what Dev points at too: QA is the environment the API was validated against and the client secret is a shared nonprod credential. Note this reads the NONPROD Db2 library, not production CTRM - see the testing caveat in docs/application-context/CTRM GraphQL Data Source.md.
Ctrm.// ClientSecret: NOT set here and never should be. Supplied from kv-orig-qa-eus as secret 'Ctrm--ClientSecret' (Key Vault maps '--' to ':'), read by the app-origination-qa-eus managed identity - the same path every other secret in this environment uses. Until that secret exists the client reports NotConfigured and every contract/ticket read fails loudly rather than silently serving ODS.
Ctrm.// TradeUnitContractBatchConcurrency: 4 on the nonprod gateway, not the base file's 8. Measured 2026-09-29 against apiqa in its slow phase with the app's exact batch: 8 at once lost all 8 to HC0045, 4 at once returned 4/4, and a 1,271-producer trade unit then completed at 4. Dev and local laptops share this gateway and this identity, so the pool sees all of them together. Remove this override only when the API team confirms the nonprod pool's per-caller concurrency.
